Combine two QWAmetadata objects

Source: R/combine_datasets.R
combine_QWAmetadata.Rd

Combines two QWAmetadata objects, e.g. prepared from separate input folders, into one. The images are combined with combine_QWAimages(), so both objects must have the same roxas_version and distinct image_label values. Where both objects contain the same entry, x takes precedence:

  • $dataset is taken from x,

  • $authors are combined and deduplicated by email, then renumbered with the authors of x first; the contact person of x is kept,

  • $funding is combined and deduplicated by entire row,

  • $related is combined and deduplicated by citation,

  • $sites, $trees, $woodpieces and $slides are combined and deduplicated by their ID column (with a warning for shared IDs with different values), and their counts are updated with update_QWAmetadata().

Usage

combine_QWAmetadata(x, y)

Arguments

x, y

QWAmetadata objects

Value

A combined QWAmetadata object

Details

Submission files only; TRIA dataset files are not edited.

See also

combine_QWAimages(), combine_QWAdata(), update_QWAmetadata()
